title: Sintel
question: What is she doing with him?
reference: Young Sintel is holding / playing with the baby dragon Scales, whom she rescued, bandaged and named; they have become close friends.
notes: 'him' refers to the dragon from the first turn. Flashback: rescue and bandaging (206–218 s), 'Good night, Scales.' (228 s), the two together until 248 s. The giant dragon snatching Scales (324 s) is future.

title: Sintel
question: 他刚才问了她什么?她怎么回答的?
reference: 老人问她来守门人之地做什么(What brings you to the land of the gatekeepers?),她回答:一条龙(A dragon.)。
notes: 'he' = the old man from the first turn. en.official:007 (129.4–133.8, eligible 134.8) and 010 'A dragon.' (143.4–145.0, eligible 146) are eligible; 011 'A dangerous quest for a lone hunter.' (148.85) is future. Reply in Chinese.

title: Tears of Steel
question: What is he drinking?
reference: A juice box (a 'MANGO COOL! FUN!' drink carton) through a straw.
notes: 'he' = the sniper from the first turn. o12 juice box eligible at 149, f016 at about 150. The name Barley is only visible from 198.2 s.

history.question: Who is the man with the sniper rifle?

title: Tears of Steel
question: Who is Barley?
reference: Barley is the sniper with the rifle in the bell tower (the one drinking from the juice box earlier).
notes: Builds on the first answer ('How's it looking, Barley?', 197.2–198.3, eligible at 199.3; the name is visible from 198.2). Cue 022 'We should have about 10 minutes.' (198.9–200.6) is eligible only at 201.6, so it must not be quoted at P=201.

title: Elephants Dream
question: What does the old man keep telling him to do with it?
reference: Proog keeps urging Emo to listen to the telephone receiver (he holds it out for him to hear).
notes: 'it' = the telephone from the first turn. Cues 020–028 (168–199.5) and e006 (174 s, the receiver held out for him to listen) are eligible. Future: cane 244 s, piston 248 s, 'pulp' from 271 s.

history.question: What is that on the stand?

title: Elephants Dream
question: And what did Emo say back?
reference: Emo calls Proog a sick man and tells him to stay away from him.
notes: Follows 'Why did Proog hit Emo?' at 465 s (e017, 460 s, is eligible). Cues 078 (465.5–466.5, eligible 467.5) and 079 (467.5–468.5, eligible 469.5) are eligible. Future: giant hand 506 s, knock-down 522 s.
